tagline: TECHNICAL SUPPORT SPECIALIST | AI-ENABLED WORKFLOWS | ESCALATION MANAGEMENT | SENIOR CUSTOMER SERVICE
paragraphs: For the past four years, I've done a version of this job every single day. As a Senior Support Associate at Maven Clinic, I owned quality assurance for our Support organization — which meant reading other people's words at volume, holding them against a written standard, and documenting exactly why something did or didn't clear the bar. When manual grading proved too subjective, I built CareBot, an AI-assisted QA system trained on our SOPs and policies that removed reviewer bias from the process entirely. It's still in use today. Evaluating content against platform guidelines — accurately, consistently, and with a paper trail — is the core skill of review moderation, and it's the one my career is built on.

The investigative side of this role is where I'd thrive most. My academic background is in statistics and quantitative modeling, and my professional instinct is the same: connect timestamps, account activity, and behavioral patterns until the data tells you whether a review is genuine. At Maven, that instinct once let me trace a wave of seemingly unrelated customer reports back to a major infrastructure outage in real time — pattern recognition under pressure, documented and escalated cleanly.
I also know how to produce in a fast-paced, independent environment. I spent four years on overnight shifts — often the most senior person online — while posting numbers like these:

Reviews are livelihoods. For the pros who build their businesses on Thumbtack, a fake review can sink an honest operation — and a wrongly removed genuine one can mislead the customers who count on the platform. I believe in getting that call right every time, and I'd love to make those calls for Thumbtack.
